errors.what: first draft of analyze.py's exact miss formula raised ValueError from math.comb when the flagged count exceeds the unopened remainder
errors.fix: guard added; caught by the new enumeration test; real data never reached that case and results.txt is byte-identical after the fix

errors.what: LOG first said the uniform 2% shrink was caught 56% at the best 0.1 T protocol (that was k = 7, the r = 2 optimum)
errors.fix: rechecked before committing: 50% at r = 15, k = 6; corrected to about 6x

doc_friction.issue: the tool layer blocks foreground `sleep` and Monitor needs its schema loaded first; waiting for a background run is simplest as a foreground `while ! grep -q ...; do sleep 15; done` loop, which the cloud-session notes could say

changing a project's project.json lede makes research/README.md's generated list stale; CI's research_live_links.py check failed, and run_workflow_locally --for-changes did not run that job. Run `python3 platform/ci/research_live_links.py --write` after editing project.json

deviations.why: the planned frontier only went to 0.4 T; after seeing m = 0 win everywhere I extended it to 1.0 T
deviations.did: kept it in analyze.py and results.txt under a 'Post hoc' heading and said so in the LOG outcome
deviations.result: found the only cell where a float32 segment helps (r = 2, about 1 T, 1.31x)

writeups: research/verifiable-training-mechanisms/LOG.md (milestone 81 plan and outcome; the programme's agent doc)

pricing.source: Anthropic pricing as cached in the Claude API skill (models table and per-model migration notes), 2026-10-06. Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour); cache reads differ by model.

human_equivalent.basis: a PhD student designing, running and writing up one simulation milestone with predictions, analysis and a blog post

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
server-tool fees (web search is billed per search, not per token); the count is recorded, not priced
